title: Independent Review Artifact Metadata
description: Contract for the metadata block of an independent-review artifact (markdown blockquote header, parsed by core/gates review). Documented as JSON for tooling; the artifact itself is markdown. The `prd` pattern shows the DEFAULT id pattern; runtime validation derives it from workflow.config idPattern. Invariant: verdict `pass` requires `critical` = 0.

reviewer.description: Tool/model identity of the reviewer — must not be the implementing agent.

baseSha.description: Merge-base (or base tip) the diff was reviewed against.

quorum.description: Reviewer panel outcome, N/M pass. The method gate is >=3/5 pass (orchestration-runner prompt); record the actual panel result. Runtime quorum arithmetic enforcement is a tracked follow-up of the engine, not this schema.
